job: ถ้าจะเปิดร้านกล้องที่นี่ จะอยู่ข้างใคร — เห็นทันทีว่าร้านกล้องกระจุกอยู่ย่านใดในภาพเมือง 3 มิติ แล้วเจาะลงถึงสถานที่ อาคาร และสาขาพร้อมหลักฐาน
audiences: ทีมขยายสาขาของเครือร้านกล้องและร้านแบรนด์ผู้ผลิต (Hypothesis)
ทีม leasing / asset ของศูนย์การค้าและศูนย์ไอที (Hypothesis)
ทีมขายและช่องทางของแบรนด์ผู้ผลิตกล้อง/โดรน (Hypothesis)
นักวิเคราะห์และที่ปรึกษาด้านทำเล
journey: เห็นข้อค้นพบระดับย่าน (Locale ของ CityMETER) ในเมือง 3 มิติที่โฟกัส 3 ย่านอันดับต้นแล้วทันที ไม่ต้องตั้งค่าตัวกรอง; ซูมออกทั้งประเทศแล้วเห็นกรอบ 64 จังหวัดที่มีร้านกล้อง กดเพื่อเจาะลง
ขยายเป็นทุกย่านด้วยการกดครั้งเดียว (ดูทุกย่าน) หรือเจาะย่านจาก breadcrumb/ป้าย; จังหวัดที่ไม่มี Locale ให้ข้อค้นพบระดับสถานที่แทน
เปิดโปรไฟล์ย่าน: ประเภทร้าน (ร้าน/สาขา) สถานที่ ร้านเฉพาะ/ร่วม และลิงก์ “ย่านนี้ใน CityMETER” ไปที่ Locale เดียวกันบน production

เจาะสถานที่ (host ของ CityMETER ที่ research master จับคู่): เฉพาะอาคารและร้านของสถานที่นั้นมีสี อาคารของสถานที่ (เมื่อ master ยอมรับอาคาร) มองเห็นเสมอ (x-ray) และกดได้ กล้องมุมสถาปนิกจัดกรอบทั้งอาคาร; เจาะร้าน อ่านสถานะ ที่อยู่ ร้านที่ร่วมหน้าร้าน หลักฐาน และระดับความแม่นของพิกัด
เปรียบเทียบย่านด้วยกราฟและตารางช่องเท่ากัน แล้วคัดรายการไปสำรวจ

changesSince.from: citymeter-luxury-brands 0.5.0 (sibling product; Camera Shops starts at 0.5.0 with the same architecture)
changesSince.ownerInstructions: 2026-10-22: “ทำแบบเดียวกัน” กับ CityMETER Luxury Brands สำหรับ Camera Shops จากชีต research ของร้านกล้อง แล้ว publish ที่ github.com/montri-th/camera
items: dataset: data/camera.json from “CityMETER Camera Shops Thailand — Research Master 2026-10-22” (one row = one outlet record; built by scripts/build-camera-data.py)
counting unit ร้าน = distinct shop banner (bannersOf/brandSet); a co-branded storefront is one outlet with every counted banner; “แบรนด์” is never a unit on screen (it would read as camera makers)
segment filter projects banners (projectSegment): an outlet stays when any of its banners is in the segment and only those banners count
ย่าน = CityMETER production Locales (26 in Bangkok, ids = Locale uuids, membership checked against production locatePoint 31/31); the neighborhood profile links to the same Locale on landometer.com

hosts: the research master venue join (07_VENUES / 02_STORES / 12_SPATIAL_JOIN) decides every host point — 106 CityMETER Shopping Center records, 179 outlets; the build re-reads each host from production and never adds, moves or upgrades a join (mallId = host record id, hostKind says which; the Grocery hypermarket kind stays supported but no row uses it); venues the master holds show พิกัดรอตรวจ and no point; outlets without a joined host keep no coordinate
venue level is fed from scopeRows (detailRows): a venue outside the automatic top-three areas still gets its pins, blue host and x-ray (when the master accepts a building for it)
desktop 3D fits count the legend (pitchedPadding) and the 3D overview is never framed below zoom 13 (CITY_MASSING_ZOOM) so the city massing is on the first screen; phones keep the full fit
provinces without a Locale get a venue-level first finding (share of banners at the leading venue) and no “0 ย่าน” tile
province frames for all 64 provinces that hold an outlet; the panel lists ten and folds the rest in a native disclosure
no store-banner logos are collected: pins carry text name chips (BANNER_LABELS for long names) under the same 250 ceiling from zoom 14
pictogram role brand (ร้าน) = photo_camera U+E412 (Luxury Brands: diamond); subset rebuilt byte-reproducibly
store facts add address, store format (FORMATS), linked banners (ร่วมกับ …), the retailer’s own map link and hold statuses; cohorts current / all / review
public files carry no phone numbers (build-time scrub) and no private Drive/Docs URLs

rebase 2026-10-22 on the research master revision 13:13 UTC (the first build used the 12:36 UTC export): host points and host buildings now come from the master’s own venue join and building join (13_BUILDINGS + its feature file); rows with a point 208 → 179, Locales 27 → 26, host buildings 136 → 103 features (69 footprints + 34 parts, 69 hosts, © OpenStreetMap contributors only); first finding 61% → 58% (22/38 ร้าน, 37/233 สาขา)

the app crosswalk (scripts/host-links/crosswalk_*.py) only proposes host links for venues the master has not joined — host_link_proposals.csv, 28 venues / 29 outlets (19 Big C / Lotus’s hypermarkets, 6 Robinson stores, 3 held venues) for the research team; never published
row field venueJoin (joined | held | awaiting_registry | no_venue) from the master venue_join_status; describeGeometry reads held as พิกัดรอตรวจ; the review cohort includes held rows (17)

venue-level finding names the leading venue that has a host point (venues without one stay in the venue list); ย่าน shows “—” for a row without a point (was “นอกย่าน”); the host-building legend key hides when no host building is displayed

scopeRows.definition: rows after search/cohort/segment/province/channel/venue filters, before neighborhood selection and area focus (segment filter = banner projection, see bannerContract.segmentFilter)

baseRows.definition: scopeRows narrowed by the selected neighborhood (Locale)
consumers: aha when a neighborhood is selected

rows.definition: baseRows narrowed by area focus (auto top-3, explicit ?areas=, or none with ?areas=all)
consumers: counters (labelled ในโฟกัส when narrowed)

auto.focusIds: top areaIds from summarizeAreaInsight (≤ 3) when no neighborhood is selected

rowScopes.venueLevel: Camera Shops: at venue level (venue mode, or a store inside a venue) detailRows() = rows of the current venue taken from scopeRows, so a venue outside the automatic focus keeps its detail; counters and the table keep using rows
rowScopes.visibleCue: chart scope caption appends ‘ทุกย่าน’ whenever rows ≠ scopeRows; counters are labelled ‘ในโฟกัส’ when focus narrows rows

firstAha.scope: baseRows (scopeRows narrowed by a selected neighborhood when present)
firstAha.ranking: top three Locales by distinct shop banners (ร้าน), then outlets (สาขา), then stable id
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {sharePercent}% ของร้านกล้องมีสาขาใน {areaCount} ย่านนี้
firstAha.numerator: union of the counted banners (bannersOf) of the outlets assigned to the top Locales — a banner present in two areas counts once, a co-branded outlet contributes each of its banners
firstAha.denominator: all distinct banners in baseRows, including outlets outside every Locale and outlets without a coordinate
firstAha.secondaryFinding: Locale with the most banners found in no other Locale within scopeRows (profile-model.js#buildOverviewInsights) — “ร้านที่พบเฉพาะย่านมากที่สุด”
firstAha.defaultCamera: city preset; fitPitched over the vertices of the focused Locales with legend-aware padding (pitchedPadding, bottom ≤ 45 % of the map height); on wide screens the result is never below zoom 13 (CITY_MASSING_ZOOM — the city and focus massing tiers start there), phones keep the full fit. Harness 1280×800: fit 12.82 → framed at 13.0; 390×844: 12.73 (Ratchada-West ↔ Siam/Ratchaprasong are about 2 km apart)
firstAha.action: ดูทุกย่าน (clears auto focus → ?areas=all; with outlets in 64 provinces the fit becomes the country plan view); เปรียบเทียบย่าน; Locale names in the Aha copy are links
firstAha.explicitAction: โฟกัส {areaCount} ย่านนี้ (shown only when focus mode is none)

fallbacks.noRows: ไม่พบสาขาตามตัวกรองนี้ + clear filter action
fallbacks.rowsOutsideAllAreas: no Locale holds a row (a province outside Bangkok — production has Locales in Bangkok only — or a filter): the finding moves to the venue level — “{share}% ของร้านกล้องมีสาขาที่ {leading venue}” = banners at the first venue in rankVenues that has a host point ÷ banners of the selection, with the next two such venues and the actions ดูสถานที่นี้ / ดูสาขา; a venue without a point (e.g. held by the research master) stays in the venue list but never carries the map finding; the ย่าน metric tile is omitted (out_of_scope, not zero). Snapshot: ?province=CMI → 80% at Central Chiangmai (4/5 ร้าน, 4/7 สาขา); ?province=PKT → 67% at Central Phuket (2/3 ร้าน, 1/5 สาขา; Central Phuket Floresta holds 2 ร้าน but is held by the research master and has no point)
fallbacks.noVenue: no venue with a host point (only street shops without a venue, or venues the research master has not joined — e.g. ?province=TAK): headline “{pos} สาขา · {brands} ร้าน” with ดูสาขา / ล้างตัวกรอง

areaRows.name: รัชดา-ตะวันตก
ราชประสงค์

mostExclusive.name: รัชดา-ตะวันตก

requirements: No login, sharing or geolocation prerequisite
Core dataset and Locale boundaries enable the area Aha; counts and table still work without boundaries; the map vendor and tiles load separately
Snapshot values are regression fixtures, never UI constants (tests/area-insight.test.js, tests/chart-model.test.js)
Returning to all (ดูทุกย่าน) clears only area focus; filters stay
3D is the default; the 3D toggle and ?view3d=0 switch to the plan preset without changing data

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else quiet (owner instruction 2026-10-22, carried over from Luxury Brands)

overviewAuto.focus: top-3 Locales: count fill, labels with banner counts, category pins, host buildings, rounded focus massing (zoom ≥ 13)
overviewAuto.quiet: other Locales outline-only with quiet labels; outlets outside focus are grey context dots without labels; city massing in the quiet tone; no name chips below zoom 14

overviewAll.focus: all 26 Locales filled by distinct banners (count family, 5 equal-interval classes), labels with counts; nationally the fit becomes the country plan view where the province frames carry the reading
overviewAll.quiet: pins are size-tiered dots; city massing only; no rounded focus massing

neighborhood.focus: selected Locale fill below zoom 14.5, selected outline, host buildings, rounded focus massing, category pins, name chips

store.focus: selected pin ring, leader line to the source coordinate, desktop popup naming every counted banner; a store inside a venue inherits the venue state

venue.focus: only the venue's own rows (from scopeRows): category pins, name chips, host building(s) in map.activeLayer drawn by the venue x-ray on top of every massing tier (always visible, clickable); camera = eye preset framed on the host footprint(s) and roof, or framePoint(zoom 16) on the host point when the host has no footprint (37 of the 106 hosts have no building accepted by the research master, e.g. Fortune Town); a venue without a host point opens its panel but does not move the camera
venue.quiet: other venues' rows are grey context dots; their host buildings fall back to quiet/focus massing; SCENE.eye lowers massing opacity (city 0.16, focus 0.62) and buildings between the camera and the venue move to the 0.14-opacity occluder layer; the city tier fades to the ground tone with distance from the focus

countryAll.focus: below zoom 9: frames of the 64 provinces that hold an outlet, filled by distinct banners per province (count family, 5 equal-interval classes of their own), ink-chip province labels with counts, legend “จังหวัด · จำนวนร้าน”, panel list “จังหวัดที่มีร้านกล้อง” (ten rows + a disclosure for the rest)
countryAll.quiet: provinces without outlets are not drawn (out_of_scope); with a จังหวัด filter the other frames are outline-only; from zoom 9 the frames are outlines until zoom 12 and the Locales carry the scale

choropleth.metric: distinct shop banners per Locale within scopeRows
choropleth.classification: equal-interval, 5 classes from the current maximum, integer closed intervals shown in the legend

evidenceStates.out_of_scope: bare basemap (every place outside the 26 Locales, i.e. every province but Bangkok)

choropleth.themePolicy: identical light HEX on both themes; fill-opacity 1 inserted before the basemap's first line layer (waterway); hard switch off at zoom ≥ 14.5

mapFocusContract.hostBuildings: map.activeLayer role (light #347DA8 / dark #65B6DB), only for detail rows, extrusion zoom ≥ 14, outline zoom ≥ 12, visible in both plan and 3D; layers camera-venue-buildings-3d / camera-venue-buildings-outline
mapFocusContract.labels: pin labels at zoom ≥ 14 for focused rows only, ≤ 250 (js/pins.js LOGO_MIN_ZOOM, MAX_LOGOS): banner logo when registered, else a text name chip (Camera Shops: always a chip, see bannerContract.labels); the map status line reads “{n} สาขา · ป้ายชื่อ {placed}/250 · บริบท {n}”
mapFocusContract.detailRows: js/app.js#detailRows: venueLevel() ? venueRows(scopeRows) — rows of the current venue (mallId, else venue label) : rows
mapFocusContract.areaLabels: ink chips (--area-label-bg/ink/border, display font, area square glyph, light count badge) so they never read as name chips or logo boxes; quiet = 72% opacity; hidden below zoom 11.5
mapFocusContract.drawOrder: host extrusion (buildings.js) is installed first; installMassing({beforeId: HOST_LAYERS.extrusion}) inserts city/focus/occluder tiers before it; venue-xray is the last 3D layer (before water-name). Reason: MapLibre 3D layers share one depth buffer and translucent fill-extrusion writes depth in its first pass, so anything drawn later and farther is cut away.

basemapContract.generator: js/map-style.js#buildMapStyle(theme, {palette, tileJSON, glyphs}) — a MapLibre style v8 object built at runtime; no hosted style URL (unchanged from Luxury Brands 0.5)

tiles.buildingLayer: building (fields render_height, render_min_height, hide_3d; available z13–14)
tiles.labels: name:th preferred, then name; no POI, housenumber or boundary labels

palette.source: assets/theme.css --basemap-* tokens (light and dark declared once each; basemap-only, not data colours)

layerOrder: massing + host buildings (inserted before MASSING_BEFORE = water-name, the first symbol layer)
area outlines, selection outline, pins, name chips
basemapContract.atmosphere: sky + fog blend the far ground into the paper colour; viewport-anchored light (#FFFFFF, intensity 0.32) gives massing a soft shade; both are quiet context, never data
basemapContract.themeSwitch: map.setStyle(buildMapStyle(theme)) then re-install spatial layers; data layers keep the same HEX on both themes

massingContract.module: js/massing.js#installMassing(map, {sourceId, beforeId, colors, tileUrl, fetchImpl}) → {update, retheme, dispose, layerIds, setScene}

cityTier.layer: city-massing (fill-extrusion, source openmaptiles, source-layer building, minzoom 13)
cityTier.height: render_height / render_min_height from the tile; hide_3d features excluded
cityTier.filter: ['all', ['!=', ['get','hide_3d'], true], ['!', ['in', ['id'], ['literal', hiddenIds]]]] — OSM twins of host buildings hidden by feature id

focusTier.source: focus-massing (GeoJSON built from the same tile URLs MapLibre loads, decoded by js/mvt.js; z14, ≤ 9 tiles per update, tiles touching the focus regions only)
focusTier.selection: buildings overlapping a focus polygon (point-in-ring or ring intersection), clipped to the tile box with buffer, host-overlapping buildings dropped
focusTier.shape: js/geometry.js: cleanRing → clipRingToBox → offsetRing(+d) → roundRing(r, 3 segments, encloseOffset d)
focusTier.visibility: 3D and plan (plan shows the rounded footprints flat)
focusTier.cacheKey: regions + hosts + zoom bucket (full zoom level) + tile availability

hostTier.source: data/venue-buildings.geojson via js/buildings.js (controller exposes displayedFeatures()); features joined to outlets by outlet_ids, to hosts by mall_ids (the Shopping Center ids of the research master join; Grocery record ids supported); the features are the research master building join (13_BUILDINGS)
hostTier.visibility: extrusion zoom ≥ 14, outline zoom ≥ 12, detail rows only; before MASSING_BEFORE
hostTier.attribution: source attribution “© OpenStreetMap contributors · CityMETER”; every feature carries attribution “© OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0)” and license ODbL-1.0 (OSM footprints and OSM-derived CityMETER building parts)

rounding.radiusMetres: roundingRadiusM(zoom, lat) = clamp(4 px in metres at max(zoom, 14.5), 3, 12)
rounding.reference: maplibre/maplibre-style-spec#1047 (polygon corner radius) is unsupported in MapLibre; rounding is done in geometry, display only

enclosure.radiusCap: radius ≤ 0.95 · d / (1 − sin(θ/2)) so the rounded ring still encloses the original polygon at every corner
enclosure.purpose: the quiet city twin stays fully inside the rounded focus solid → no z-fighting without hiding it; host twins are hidden instead because the host solid is the data layer

massingContract.provenance: building heights and footprints of the city and focus tiers are OSM via OpenFreeMap (defaults when no height tag); context only, never a claim of this dataset; OpenFreeMap merges same-height buildings into MultiPolygons, so single roofs cannot be picked

scene.occluderLayer: focus-massing-occluding (same source as the focus tier; filter by unique feature ids; the focus tier excludes them)
scene.occlusionTest: screen-space: a focus building whose box (ground vertices + tops lifted by height × local px/m × sin(pitch)) overlaps a target's box and whose mean ground y is larger (nearer the camera) is an occluder; recomputed on moveend and after each tile update; targets = the venue's host rings (displayedFeatures filtered by mall_ids / venue_names) with display_height_m

distanceFade.rule: city-tier colour interpolates from --basemap-massing-quiet (fade 0) to --basemap-ground (fade 1, invisible) by distance from the nearest focus anchor (area centroid; every area when nothing is focused)
distanceFade.mechanism: feature-state `fade` written once per building id after tiles load (querySourceFeatures on sourcedata/moveend); anchors change → states rebuilt
distanceFade.why: MapLibre has no camera-distance expression and fill-extrusion-opacity is not data-driven

cameraContract.module: js/camera.js (CAMERA, presetFor, applyPreset, fitPitched, framePoint, shiftPadding, projectPoint)

plan.when: view3d off (3D toggle / ?view3d=0) or bounds wider than 0.3° (e.g. ดูทุกย่าน over 64 provinces)

model.when: neighborhood in 3D (and venue level when มุมสถาปนิก is switched off) — near-axonometric, verticals upright

eye.when: venue level only (venue mode, or a store inside a venue): on by default, ?cam=model opts out; disabled elsewhere and in 2D; on mobile portrait it waits until the sheet closes
eye.constraint: MapLibre 5.6.2 draws fill-extrusion displaced or not at all once the horizon enters the viewport (pitch > 90 − fov/2) — verified live on Luxury Brands 2026-10-22 (pitch 73 ok, 76 displaced, 82 missing); the eye preset keeps the horizon just outside the frame (90 − 12 − 3 = 75)

fitting.function: fitPitched(map, bounds, {preset, padding, maxZoom 16, minZoom 10, points, shift, apply})
fitting.method: start from cameraForBounds (flat), apply preset pitch/bearing/FOV, zoom out in 0.1 steps until every point (polygon vertices when given, else bbox corners) projects inside the padded viewport, then zoom in while they still fit; jumps are computed without rendering and the final camera is animated
fitting.padding: Camera Shops: desktop 3D padding counts the legend — bottom = max(chart tray + 40, map bottom − legend top + 12), capped at 45 % of the map height (Luxury Brands ignored the legend); mobile portrait uses the flat cameraPadding, with the sheet open plan, then re-frames in 3D on sheet close
fitting.overviewFloor: fitMap: on wide screens a city-preset fit below zoom 13 (CITY_MASSING_ZOOM) is applied at zoom 13 with the same centre, so the 3D massing is on the first screen even when the focus areas are far apart; phones keep the full fit so all three named areas stay visible
fitting.bearing: 28° (family value from Luxury Brands); for Camera Shops the top-3 Locales lie on a north-east axis (Siam/Ratchaprasong → Ratchada-West)
fitting.venue: frameVenue: fitPitched over the host footprint vertices AND roof vertices (vertex + display_height_m, projected with camera.projectPoint through transform.modelViewProjectionMatrix), top padding 12% (eye) / 10% (model), maxZoom 17.6, minZoom = max(14.5, footprint-only fit − 1); falls back to framePoint(zoom 16) when no host building is displayed or on mobile portrait
fitting.neighborhood: fitArea: fitPitched over the Locale outline vertices, maxZoom 17.5 so the outline fills the frame

maplibre.requires: setVerticalFieldOfView (≥ 4.7), maxPitch 85; keep pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3 for any fill-extrusion view
maplibre.orthographic: not available in MapLibre; narrow FOV is the standard substitute

cameraContract.alternatives: deck.gl custom projectionMatrix or three.js camera.setViewOffset give a true two-point camera; not adopted to keep a single MapLibre scene

breadcrumbContract.module: js/breadcrumb.js (buildBreadcrumb, renderBreadcrumb, breadcrumbText) + js/model.js PROVINCES (all 77 production provinces)
levels: จังหวัด (ชื่อไทย = the rows' province value; production code in the URL)
ย่าน (CityMETER production Locale; from point-in-polygon on the venue's representative point when a venue is open — Bangkok only)
สถานที่ (venue: CityMETER host record id — the Shopping Center id the research master joined; a Grocery record id is supported — else plain venue label)

productionPath.observed: https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{PROVINCE_CODE} (codes = production base/info/lv0 abbrEn, e.g. BKK, CMI, NST, UTT); /v3/citymeter/BKK/L/{locale uuid}?d=shoppingCenter is a valid production route (checked 2026-10-22) and every ย่าน id of this product is a production Locale uuid
productionPath.localeMapping: neighborhood id = production Locale uuid, so ?neighborhood={uuid} ≡ /v3/citymeter/BKK/L/{uuid}; the neighborhood profile links there (“ย่านนี้ใน CityMETER”)
productionPath.proposal: /v3/citymeter/{PROVINCE_CODE}/L/{locale uuid}/V/{host id}?d=cameraShops for the venue level
productionPath.status: Inference — the venue-level path and a cameraShops dataset key are proposals, not implemented in production

breadcrumbContract.demoQuery: ?province=BKK&neighborhood=<locale uuid>&place=<host id> (code preferred; Thai or English province names still resolve via provinceNameFrom)

breadcrumbContract.dataBinding: data/neighborhoods.geojson properties.provinceCode = BKK / provinceName = กรุงเทพมหานคร for all 26 Locales; rows carry the Thai province name
actions: crumb-venue (re-open the venue profile by id or label)
crumb-expand (unfold collapsed levels on narrow screens)
breadcrumbContract.documentTitle: breadcrumbText(crumbs) · Camera Shops · CityMETER drives document.title
venueRules: a venue outside every Locale, or without a host point, skips the ย่าน level (ประเทศไทย › ภูเก็ต › Central Phuket; ประเทศไทย › กรุงเทพมหานคร › Siam Square One)

venue ids come from data/camera.json centers[].id (Shopping Center: landometer.com/api/v2/citymeter-v3/shopping-center/detail/{id}; a Grocery record id is supported for hypermarket hosts but no row uses one in this release)

limitations: Listings are source observations, not field-verified operating status.
Coordinates are shopping-centre host points from the research master venue join, not shop entrances or floors.
Outlets the research master has not joined to a host (held, awaiting a registry match, or without a venue) keep missing coordinates.
Coverage is not a national census of camera retail.
Do not infer sales, stock, spending or demographics from presence.

invariants.rule: One outlet record owns one pin; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context pins; a co-branded storefront is one pin, never one per banner
250 pin labels (logo or name chip) is a ceiling, never a quota; labels only at zoom ≥ 14 and only for rows in focus
Preserve original logo artwork when a registry exists; a name chip is text, never a substitute or generated logo
Default first insight concerns neighborhoods (Locales), not venues; the venue-level finding appears only when no Locale holds a row and names only a venue that has a host point
Never sum distinct banners across areas, venues or segments; use set union
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of UI; retain provenance in documentation and real closure/hold/error states
No CSV download UI
No decorative bracket or colored left rail; keep visible focus
No fabricated coordinates, store openings, administrative boundaries or consumer behaviour claims; no nearest-neighbour host or building joins; retailer map links are never decoded into coordinates
Pins, counters, table and panel counts use the same committed rows; Aha, choropleth and charts use scopeRows and say so when they differ; at venue level the venue's rows come from scopeRows
Detail only for the focused part; everything else stays visible but quiet (no labels, grey dots, outline-only areas, quiet massing)
Analytical colours keep the approved light HEX on both themes; contrast is solved with labels, outlines and backplates, never by recolouring data
Exclusive/shared and the Aha denominator reference the whole filtered scope, never a single selected area
The first view is 3D with the top-3 Locales focused (desktop never below zoom 13); ?areas=all and the 3D toggle are the only ways to leave that state, and neither changes the data
Basemap and massing colours come only from --basemap-* tokens; they never reuse data, series or state colours, and massing never encodes a metric
City massing is OSM context: rounding and enclosure are display-only, heights are never quoted as dataset facts, and host buildings stay the only building layer that carries data colour
Breadcrumb levels are ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › ย่าน › สถานที่ with production province codes; ย่าน ids are production Locale uuids and are never invented — outside Bangkok there is no ย่าน level
Matrix cells are equal in size; only the number and its count class carry meaning
Camera presets never move or scale data; the eye preset is the venue-level camera only (default there, ?cam=model opts out) and never applies to overview or neighborhood

At venue level only the venue's rows carry detail: its host building is the only blue one; other venues' buildings and pins become quiet context; the eye scene only changes massing opacity, never data

On-screen copy is short and natural, without caveats: ร้าน = distinct shop banner, สาขา = one outlet record, สถานที่ = venue, ย่าน = Locale; “แบรนด์” is never a unit; provenance, units and limits live in the data section, help and docs
The venue's host building is never hidden by context: it is drawn before every massing tier and the venue x-ray draws it on top in 3D; it stays clickable via the style layer and the x-ray hit-test
Province frames are navigation context with their own count classes; they never replace the Locale scale above zoom 9 and never claim administrative authority
Pictograms are decorative: every tile and heading keeps its text label; the nav-7 approved subset stays byte-identical and the pictogram subset (brand = photo_camera) is a declared test exception
Venue logos identify, never decide: lookup by host id or exact label only, the venue name stays the record, and shared or parent-complex marks carry their role
Counted banners = retail and host-counter banners of 11_STORE_BRANDS; an operator is never a banner; a segment filter projects banners on a copy of the row and never drops, merges or moves an outlet

A coordinate is the point of the CityMETER host record the research master joined (a Shopping Center in this release; the Grocery kind is supported) and is described as a host point; the build never adds, moves or upgrades a master join; outlets without a joined host — held, awaiting a registry match or without a venue — keep a null coordinate and stay in every count and the table
Public files never carry phone numbers or private Drive/Docs/googleusercontent URLs

Identity, unit and location holds — including venues the research master holds (venueJoin held, พิกัดรอตรวจ) — stay in the default cohort with their own pending status; the listed contact location is outside the default and selectable (cohorts all / review)
Display labels (BANNER_LABELS, FORMATS, hostTypeLabel, SEGMENT_SHORT) never change a row, a search key or a count

join.checks: per joined venue: the production Shopping Center detail exists; the master latitude/longitude equal the detail point (106/106 exact, tolerance 0.0005°); the point lies in the production province polygon of the venue’s province (decoded base/mvt/P); every Bangkok host point gets its Locale from production base/locatePoint and the shipped Locale polygons must agree (31/31); every outlet of a joined venue carries the same host id and point and no held or unjoined outlet carries one — the build stops otherwise
join.venues: 144 research venues → 106 joined (106 host records) · 32 named venues awaiting a registry match · 6 held: Siam Square One (CityMETER point and an unnamed underground polygon conflict with the official Fujifilm tenant map), Central Phuket Floresta (the other side from Festival), ท็อปส์ ซูเปอร์สโตร์ พะเยา, มาร์คโฟร์ แพร่, ไชยแสง สิงห์บุรี, ไอที พลาซ่า สำโรง
join.proposals: the app’s own reviewed crosswalk (scripts/host-links/crosswalk_sc.py, crosswalk_grocery.py) proposes host records for venues the master has not joined — host_link_proposals.csv, 28 venues / 29 outlets: 19 Big C / Lotus’s hypermarkets (Grocery records; 18 address match, 1 sole), 6 Robinson stores (Shopping Center records named only “Robinson”; sole in the province), 3 held venues; internal, never published; a link appears in the app only after the master marks it joined. For venues the master joined, the crosswalk is a cross-check: it covers 74, agrees on 73 (โลตัส สุราษฎร์ธานี: the master uses Shopping Center 4c60b013, the review had a Grocery record)

geometry.point: the host record point is the outlet coordinate for every row of that venue (co-located outlets keep separate pins via screen-space slots)
geometry.buildings: data/venue-buildings.geojson = the research master building join: 103 features (69 footprints + 34 parts) for 69 hosts and 119 outlet rows; every feature equals its 13_BUILDINGS row (id, geometry sha256 of the compact JSON, heights, linked outlet count) and every linked outlet is a joined outlet of the feature’s host. Master rules: point containment and host-name identity are separate tests, candidates failing identity are held; no nearest-building substitution, rectangle/circle footprints or heights spread from the tallest part; parts only with a complete polygon inside a qualified parent, exact base/top kept. 37 of the 106 hosts have no accepted building (e.g. Fortune Town: framed on the host point, no x-ray)

renderMapping.source_footprint: extrusion; outline when height_status = unknown_parent_height_parts_owned (the parts carry the heights)
renderMapping.none (3 new CityMETER parts): extrusion between base_m and top_m of 13_BUILDINGS

geometry.limits: a footprint is the host building, not the shop unit; heights are source or model estimates (3 m display fallback when unknown)
